scientific_integrity: The calculation gives a complete intrinsic Frobenius-metric John ellipsoid for \(2\le m<n\) and \(1\le k<m\). It relies on the established bipartite matching-polytope halfspace theorem, symmetry, and a proved strictly concave determinant maximization. Finite exact tests corroborate, rather than establish, the infinite-domain proof. No independent verification or publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Square \(m=n\), saturated \(k=m\), general sparse bipartite edge sets, and other ambient metrics are outside the statement; equivalent earlier exact formulas under optimal-design or transportation terminology may exist.
title: Three contact regimes for rectangular assignment-polytope John ellipsoids
